Name the key parts of a [[kw:check]].
back: Date, [[kw:payee]], [[kw:numeric amount]], [[kw:verbal amount]], [[kw:signature]], [[kw:memo]], and the [[kw:MICR line]].
The MICR line contains [[imp:routing number]], [[imp:account number]], and [[imp:check number]].
[[imp:The verbal amount is the legal amount]] if it differs from the numeric.
[[imp:Magnetic Ink Character Recognition line at the bottom of a check.]]
Contains the [[kw:routing number]] (9 digits), [[kw:account number]], and [[kw:check number]].
Used for high‑speed electronic processing by banks.

Always include the cents as a fraction over 100, and add "Dollars" at the end.

cards.front: How does a [[kw:debit card]] differ from a [[kw:credit card]]?
back: [[imp:Debit card takes money directly from your checking account.]]
Credit card is a short‑term loan from the bank; you pay later.
Debit transactions reduce your [[kw:available balance]] immediately.
